lean.statement:
∀     {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {f g : E → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x),
    Laplacian.laplacian (fun z => f z * g z) x =
      f x * Laplacian.laplacian g x +
      2 * inner ℝ (gradient f x) (gradient g x) +
      g x * Laplacian.laplacian f x
approved_definition_context: E is a real normed additive group with real inner product and finite real dimension. Dimension zero is allowed; no Nontrivial instance is required.

f and g are real-valued functions on E; x is one point. ContDiffAt R2 means twice continuously Frechet differentiable locally at that point, not merely existence of a pointwise second derivative and not global smoothness.

Laplacian.laplacian is the actual canonical-covariant-tensor trace of the second Frechet derivative in finite-dimensional real Hilbert space. gradient is the actual Riesz representative of the Frechet derivative; inner R is the actual real inner product. These operators are not defined by the equality being asserted.
